title: From using AI
to creating it.
intro: Small, efficient AI that acts autonomously.
description: Design, train, evaluate—and bring your models to life.
focus: Small generative models / Autonomous distributed AI / Games & interactive systems
pillarsTitle: Three pillars of education and research in our lab.

pillars.label: BUILD FROM SCRATCH
pillars.title: Create your own generative AI.
pillars.description: Design and implement models using our small Transformer implementations and latent diffusion models planned for release. Explore compact, practical generative AI with applications in industry.

pillars.label: RESEARCH MEETS PRACTICE
pillars.title: Learn from research and industry.
pillars.description: Receive direct guidance from the CTO of Cygames and the director of Cygames Research. Connect model design, training infrastructure, evaluation, and deployment through experience in AI research and large-scale services.

pillars.label: GLOBAL COLLABORATION
pillars.title: Connect your research to the world.
pillars.description: Participate in collaborations with institutions including UC San Diego, Tokyo University of the Arts, Institute of Science Tokyo, and Keio University. Work with researchers in Japan and abroad, with the aim of submitting to international conferences.
